skill.name: clinical-decision-support
skill.description: Generate clinical decision support documents for pharmaceutical research, clinical trial analysis, and guideline development. The skill focuses on cohort analyses, biomarker stratification, evidence grading, treatment algorithms, and publication-ready LaTeX reports.
skill.summary: Create research-focused clinical decision support reports with cohort analysis, biomarker logic, and GRADE recommendations.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by clinical terminology, Markdown code formatting, and LaTeX/TikZ syntax. No prompt injection, credential access, network activity, or malicious command execution was found in the reviewed locations. One medium semantic issue remains: user-controlled values are written into LaTeX without escaping.

remediation.issue: User-provided labels and table values are interpolated into LaTeX output.
remediation.suggestion: Add a central LaTeX escaping helper and apply it to CSV, JSON, and text-derived values before writing .tex files.

remediation.issue: Report scripts can overwrite files at selected output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Warn before overwriting existing files or add a no-clobber option for generated report artifacts.

remediation.issue: The skill processes clinical research data that may contain sensitive health information.
remediation.suggestion: Require de-identified inputs in examples and document safe local handling before running scripts or generating PDFs.

semantic_findings.description: Helper scripts insert user-provided algorithm text and cohort table values directly into LaTeX output. Crafted input could alter generated documents or become risky when compiled with unsafe TeX settings.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly interpolates CLI, JSON, and CSV-derived text into LaTeX without an escaping helper. Exploitability depends on later compilation and TeX engine settings.

content.value_statement: Clinical research teams need consistent reports for cohort evidence and treatment decisions. This skill structures biomarker analyses, GRADE recommendations, and LaTeX-ready clinical documents.
actual_capabilities: Drafts patient cohort analysis reports with biomarker strata, outcomes, and statistical summaries.
Creates treatment recommendation reports with GRADE evidence levels and decision algorithms.
Provides LaTeX templates for cohort, biomarker, pathway, and evidence synthesis documents.
Includes helper scripts for Kaplan-Meier curves, cohort tables, decision trees, and validation checks.
Uses reference material for biomarker classification, outcome analysis, evidence synthesis, and clinical pathways.
limitations: It is not intended for bedside care or individual patient treatment plans.
Clinical and statistical outputs require expert review before use in decisions or submissions.
Generated medical recommendations can become outdated as guidelines and labels change.
Scripts require clean input data and local Python dependencies that are not bundled.

use_cases.title: Analyze Trial Cohorts
use_cases.description: Build a biomarker-stratified cohort report with outcomes, tables, and survival summaries.

use_cases.title: Prepare Evidence Recommendations
use_cases.description: Create a GRADE-based treatment recommendation document for a disease area or therapy sequence.

use_cases.title: Draft Guideline Materials
use_cases.description: Organize evidence tables, decision pathways, and monitoring guidance for guideline discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Cohort Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a small study summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a cohort analysis report for my study. Use disease state, cohort size, biomarker groups, treatment exposure, response outcomes, and safety findings that I provide.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Biomarker Subgroups
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this cohort by biomarker subgroup. Include baseline characteristics, response rates, PFS, OS, hazard ratios, confidence intervals, and a concise clinical interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Treatment Recommendations
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced report for guideline or medical affairs review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an evidence-based treatment recommendation report for this disease setting. Grade each recommendation with GRADE, cite key trials, include monitoring guidance, and describe biomarker decision criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full CDS Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that combines evidence, algorithms, and report outputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a complete clinical decision support package using my de-identified cohort data and evidence summary. Include an executive summary, cohort tables, survival interpretation, biomarker logic, treatment algorithm, limitations, and review checklist.

A summary of evidence quality and uncertainty.
Practical next steps for validation, monitoring, and periodic update review.

best_practices: Use only de-identified data and document the de-identification method before generating reports.
Provide assay names, cut points, cohort definitions, and follow-up time with each analysis request.
Have a qualified clinician and statistician review recommendations, evidence grades, and outputs.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to create individual bedside treatment plans.
Do not treat generated recommendations as final medical advice or regulatory-ready content.
Do not compile generated LaTeX from untrusted data without sanitization and safe TeX settings.

faq.question: Is this skill for individual patient care?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for group-level clinical research, evidence synthesis, and guideline support.

faq.question: What document formats does it emphasize?
faq.answer: It emphasizes publication-ready LaTeX and PDF-style clinical decision support documents.

faq.question: Can it analyze biomarker subgroups?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports biomarker stratification, molecular subtypes, and outcome comparisons by subgroup.

faq.question: Does it replace clinical review?
faq.answer: No. A qualified clinician must review medical conclusions, safety guidance, and recommendation strength.

faq.question: Does it include statistical helpers?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes helper scripts for survival curves, cohort tables, and related summaries.

faq.question: What data should users provide?
faq.answer: Users should provide de-identified cohort data, endpoint definitions, biomarker methods, treatment exposure, and evidence sources.
